Privacy Policy

Escape Clothing respects your privacy. We collect information you provide during checkout including name, email, phone, and shipping address to process orders.

Data We Collect

  • Contact and shipping information
  • Payment details (processed securely via Cashfree)
  • Order history and preferences

How We Use Data

To process orders, provide customer support, send order updates, and improve our services. We never sell your personal data.

Cookies

We use cookies for cart functionality, analytics, and marketing pixels (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel when enabled).

Contact

For privacy concerns, email support@escapeclothing.shop
